cases.refreshed: Need help with 3D printing or looking for guided, hands-on experience? This session is ideal for beginners seeking practical experience, guided support, and confidence in using 3D printing technology. This is also a good opportunity for those who attended our 3D Design & Printing workshop and now want to try their hands at it. Participants will have the opportunity to print a simple model under supervision. If you do not have a design, you may choose a free design from Thingiverse or a similar site. All designs are printed in one PLA filament color chosen by the program lead. Designs must print in 1 hour and 45 minutes. If you're unsure how long your design will take to print, email cz.sjpl@sjlibrary.org. All designs must be compatible with the Creality K1C printer. Final approval of printability will be determined by the program lead. SJPL reserves the right to refuse any print request. One appointment per month per person.

cases.refreshed: Join your community to help beautify your Pearl Avenue Branch Library! Register to take part in this opportunity to Volunteer Away Your Fines at a rate of $20 per hour. This is a perfect opportunity for anyone interested in volunteering away their library fines, gaining service hours for school/work, or just giving back to the community. This event will be happening at the Pearl Avenue Branch Library only. Details and Requirements: Must arrive promptly to sign in at the Information Desk; Must sign a waiver form provided (parents must sign for those under the age of 18); Anyone under the age of 15 must volunteer alongside a parent/guardian; Must be able to commit to the full session (3:30 PM - 4:30 PM); No experience or special skills necessary; Training and supplies will be provided. For more information email pamail@sjlibrary.org or call 408-808-3053.
